purpose: Both-states controls for the P25-P36 stopping expressions. Each metrics_satisfying snapshot MUST evaluate True and each metrics_not_satisfying snapshot MUST evaluate False against the same tree; the not_satisfying snapshot is produced by flipping ONE leaf off the satisfying one, so a decorative conjunct is exposed by its own control refusing to fail. Snapshots are computed by exhaustive leaf-polarity search, not assumed, so a leaf under NOT or inside a WEIGHTED clause is handled correctly.
companion: PROTOCOL-EXPECTATIONS.json (sibling lane build/proto-2, P13-P24) uses this shape

custom_metric_producers.why_not_in_the_leaf: SEM-001 requires parse(source_expression) == expression exactly and the parser cannot emit a producer key, so putting the producer in the leaf turns an advisory SEM-012 warning into a hard SEM-001 error. Measured: 11 SEM-001 errors and 11/12 files rejected. The map below carries the same information and build.py fails the lane if any custom metric is missing from it.

manifest.stopping_expression: independent_positions >= 3 AND all_participants_spoke == true AND custom:provenance_leak_count <= 0 AND custom:divergence_audit_complete == true
unique_ideas >= 200 AND duplicate_ratio <= 0.5 AND no_new_idea_rounds >= 2 AND diversity_index >= 0.6
rounds_elapsed >= 3 AND every_objection_addressed == true AND custom:cycle1_candidate_distance >= 0.25 AND NOT unresolved_load_bearing_counterexample >= 1
completeness_score >= 0.95 AND custom:known_option_recall >= 1 AND custom:axis_pair_correlation <= 0.3 AND custom:unreasoned_infeasible_cells <= 0
rounds_elapsed >= 6 AND all_participants_spoke == true AND custom:off_hat_contribution_rate <= 0.05 AND custom:hats_worn >= 6
custom:binding_constraints_identified >= 1 AND custom:unrelaxable_violations <= 0 AND owner_approved == true AND custom:constraints_enumerated >= 1
custom:failure_only_mechanisms >= 1 AND custom:success_only_mechanisms >= 1 AND every_objection_addressed == true AND custom:unfalsifiable_success_causes <= 0
custom:unresolvable_questions <= 0 AND custom:questions_registered >= 3 AND independent_positions >= 4 AND all_participants_spoke == true
custom:futures_stress_tested >= 4 AND custom:driver_pair_correlation <= 0.3 AND every_objection_addressed == true AND custom:worst_case_named_per_option == true
custom:unresolvable_reference_class_citations <= 0 AND custom:reference_classes_named >= 1 AND custom:estimate_spread_ratio <= 2 AND rounds_elapsed >= 2
custom:unbanded_verdicts <= 0 AND custom:outcomes_recorded >= 1 AND all_participants_spoke == true AND custom:weights_pinned_until_proven == true
